content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第1章人生也是一盘棋（..）时间：2024年6月30日
地点：彩云大学男生宿舍1号楼404室
……
胡子拉碴、头发凌乱的周望正和最后一个离开的室友告别。
“狗哥，真不去我家玩两天啊？”
“不了，明天还有个面试。”
“那行吧，走了啊，微信联系！”
目送室友拉着行李箱消失在走廊转角，周望看着空荡荡的寝室，吐了口气，拿起扫把开始做最后的清扫。
终究还是毕业了啊……
后天就是截止离校的日期，刚刚离开的最后一个室友因为是省城本地人，所以走的最晚。
离家远还有已经找好工作的那几個，早两天就已经陆续离开。
清扫完成的周望坐在椅子上，面色迷惘之中透着一抹不甘。
那自己呢？
他拿起屏幕碎了一角的小米12，重新点开了某团的APP，找到火车票的班次列表。
他家就在同省的靖城，离省城并不远，城际列车一个半小时直达，明天可选的班次也很多，甚至可以今天就走。
他大部分行李都已经提前寄了回去，学校只留下了一部分日用品，也没什么可收拾的。
但……周望却迟迟下不了最后的决心。
父母前两天就打来电话，意见很一致，让周望回去找工作。
毕竟只是普通家庭，在省城买房本来就很吃力，之前家里又出了点变故，雪上加霜，更不可能给周望什么支持。
小城市生活压力不大，再加上父母差不多有点人脉，找个差不多的工作，娶个差不多的女孩，一辈子差不多也就这样……

呸，老子不是rapper！
突然响起的手机提示音打乱了周望的思绪。
他低头看了看，是班级群出现了“@”
的信息，不过不是专门找他的，而是群昵称显示“是丁一啊”
的女生@了所有人。
“同学们，下个月3号刚好是我的生日宴，到时候如果还有在省城的欢迎来玩呀，私我就好了——如有打扰请见谅，祝大家前程似锦，一帆风顺！”
“小猫招手.gif”
盯着对方的头像，周望眼神之中掠过一丝复杂。
丁一是他们班里最靓丽的女生，也是彩云大学数次校花评选里永不落榜的存在，白皙光洁的不像本地人的皮肤，一点点混血基因构筑的明媚五官，再加上高挑的身材和夺命的腿，不知是多少男生心中的女神。
说起来，曾经的周望还和对方有过一段小暧昧的时期。
毕竟周望本身长的也不差，平平无奇的系草罢了，在大家还相对单纯的大一时期，还是挺能打的。
可惜后来家里出了变故，自己想博一个未来的周望创业失败，加上某件事的发生，周望消沉了很长一段时间，和丁一自然也就渐行渐远。
现如今，两人可能比普通同学还要生疏些。
面前还未合上的笔记本电脑里，停留着游戏的界面，是周望玩了三年的“云顶之弈”
，俗称“下棋”
“你已被淘汰：排名第八。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Financial Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 1 Life is also a game of chess (..) Time: June 30, 2024
Location: Room 404, Building 1, Men’s Dormitory, Caiyun University
…
Zhou Wang, who was unshaven and with messy hair, was saying goodbye to the last roommate to leave.
"Brother Dog, you really don't want to come to my house and play for two days?"
"No, there is an interview tomorrow."
"Okay, let's go, contact us via WeChat!"
Watching his roommate disappear around the corner of the corridor with his suitcase, Zhou Wang looked at the empty dormitory, exhaled, picked up the broom and began to do the final cleaning.
I finally graduated...
The day after tomorrow is the deadline to leave school. The last roommate who just left is the last to leave because he is a native of the provincial capital.
Those who were far away from home and had already found jobs had already left one after another two days ago.
After finishing the cleaning, Zhou Wang sat on the chair, with a confused look on his face showing a hint of unwillingness.
What about yourself?
He picked up the Xiaomi Mi 12 with a corner of the screen broken, re-opened the APP of a certain group, and found the train ticket schedule list.
His home is in Jingcheng in the same province, not far from the provincial capital. The intercity train goes directly to it in an hour and a half. There are many trains available for tomorrow, and you can even leave today.
Most of his luggage has been sent back in advance. The school only left some daily necessities and there was nothing to pack.
But... Zhou Wang couldn't make up his mind.
His parents called two days ago and agreed that Zhou Wang should go back and find a job.
After all, they are just an ordinary family. It is already very difficult to buy a house in the provincial capital. Something happened to the family before, which made things worse. It was impossible to give Zhou Wang any support.
Life in a small city is not very stressful, plus my parents have some connections, so I can find a similar job and marry a similar girl, and that's pretty much it for the rest of my life...
Bah, I’m not a rapper!
The sudden ringing of a cell phone notification disrupted Zhou Wang's thoughts.
He looked down and saw "@" appeared in the class group
information, but it was not specifically looking for him, but the group nickname showed "It's Ding Yi"
The girl @ everyone.
"Students, the 3rd of next month happens to be my birthday party. If you are still in the provincial capital, you are welcome to come and have fun. I'll just tell you. Please forgive me for disturbing you. I wish you all a bright future and smooth sailing!"
"Kitten waving.gif"
Staring at the other person's profile picture, Zhou Wang's eyes flashed with a hint of complexity.
Ding Yi is the most beautiful girl in their class, and she has always been one of the most beautiful girls in Caiyun University. She has fair and smooth skin that does not look like the locals, bright facial features built with a little bit of mixed-race genes, coupled with a tall figure and killer legs, she is the goddess in the hearts of many boys.
Speaking of which, Zhou Wang once had a period of slight ambiguity with the other party.
After all, Zhou Wang himself is not bad in appearance, he is just an average grass-tie. During his freshman year when everyone was still relatively simple, he was still quite capable of playing.
Unfortunately, something happened at home, and Zhou Wang's plan to start a future business failed. In addition, something happened, which made Zhou Wang depressed for a long time, and he and Ding Yi naturally drifted apart.
Nowadays, the two of them may be stranger than ordinary classmates.
In the laptop that has not yet been closed in front of him, there is the interface of the game. It is "Team Tactics" that Zhou Wang has been playing for three years.
, commonly known as "playing chess"
"You have been eliminated: number eight."
